name: Hydrothermal / Solvothermal Synthesis - Bulk Oxide
description: Precursor solution or gel is crystallized in a sealed vessel above the boiling point of the solvent, then filtered, washed, dried and calcined. The industrial route for zeolites and for nanostructured titania, ceria and zirconia.

step_quantities.note: Hydrothermal crystallization; the autoclave is costed at the crystallizer rate

source: Campanati, Fornasari and Vaccari, Fundamentals in the preparation of heterogeneous catalysts, Catal. Today 77, 299 (2003); Perego and Villa, Catalyst preparation methods, Catal. Today 34, 281 (1997)
route_note: The same crystallizer proxy the zeolite routes use. Pressure-vessel time is what sets the cost, so a long crystallization is a multiple of this step.
uncosted_operations: Pressure autoclave (120-250 C, autogenous pressure): costed at the crystallizer rate; there is no pressure-vessel rate in the Step Library
